text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm at the school store
with Sakura
Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I am! I want to try making some origami.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I recently received a fan letter that came
with an
origami cherry blossom. I could
tell how much
feeling the sender put
into it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to fold something for
them too
when I write a reply back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a regular Umamusume... There's
nothing
spectacular about me that
would catch anyone's
eye.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But still... there are people out there
cheering for
me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Their words are so kind, it makes me
want to cry
when I read them... They
warm my heart and make
the fire in me
burn brighter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It all just feels like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to live up to their
expectations.
choice_data_list: それで、チヨノオーはどうしたい？
choice_data_list_en: So, what do you want to do, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to show my gratitude to my
supporters. I
want to make the people
cheering for me happy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to gift them my smile... A smile as
beautiful
as a flower in bloom!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a flower as beautiful as the
origami
cherry blossom I received!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm thinking of sending them an
even bigger
origami cherry blossom in
return!
choice_data_list: じゃあ、まずはお返しをしないとな
じゃあ、まずはお返しをしないとね
choice_data_list_en: Then first, I have to return the favor.
Then first, I've got to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That way, they'll know I'm going to
bloom into a
huge flower!
